fields.subject: ExpressionHelpers
fields.condition: a parameter name is not yet present in the caller's parameter-name set
fields.trigger: an input or output query-contract parameter expression is requested
fields.response: append one provider parameter-add expression with the supplied optional metadata only when the ignore-parameter set exists and does not contain that parameter name
fields.postcondition: the generated expression list contains at most one add operation for that parameter name
